title: clausena lansium
intro: Clausena lansium, commonly known as the Indonesian or Thai lime, is a tropical evergreen tree native to Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include lowering cholesterol levels, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Clausena lansium include anti-diarrheal, anti-ulcer, and anti-cancer properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive compounds in Clausena lansium, including limonoids and terpenoids, are also responsible for its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and hepatoprotective effects.
